cases.name: a crate carries the real animal, and there is only ever one
cases.description: Port 5651. The crate item runs our interaction, not vanilla's. A resident goes into a crate: its record waits, recovery makes no second copy past its delay, its place in the house is free. Opening the crate brings the same record back. take stands in for the swing a test player cannot make: it runs the capture our interaction runs.

steps.name: wait: creative mode is on, which /clear needs
the crate item runs our interaction
wait: the floor is down and the air is clear
the tooltip line reached the player
the crate in hand names the animal and its own tooltip key
the record is in the crate
its place in the house is free
wait: longer than the recovery delay and a sweep
a player who joins gets the line too
the crate is empty now: opening it again does nothing

cases.description: Port 5652. An admin brings a crated animal back with resummon, as they would for a lost crate. The crate no longer holds it: opening it says so, goes empty and makes nothing.
